units.source_text: 她脸色苍白，有点精疲力尽。

en.t: Her face was pale, and she seemed somewhat exhausted.

units.source_text: 百合子拘束地低下头来。
舞女在楼下同客店里的小孩儿玩耍，一看见我，她就央求阿妈让她去看电影。

en.t: The dancer was downstairs playing with the children of the inn, and as soon as she saw me, she begged Mother to let her go to the movies.

units.source_text: 结果，她脸上掠过一抹失望的阴影，茫然若失地回到了我这边，替我摆好了木屐。

en.t: In the end, a shadow of disappointment passed over her face, and she came back to my side looking lost, then set out my wooden clogs for me.
